# CANDIDATE: CURRENT_ENGINE_BASELINE

**Filed:** 2026-07-22
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** quality_gate
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The current engine's performance on the full 16-month SPY 5-min dataset is unknown. Running the Stage-1 backtest will provide the baseline edge_capture and wide_pnl, which is necessary to evaluate any strategy changes against the OP-16 anchors.

## Mechanism

Run the Stage-1 backtest via the autoresearch grinder harness on the current engine (no changes to params or heartbeat) over the full 16-month SPY 5-min dataset. Compute edge_capture using the OP-16 anchor days and wide_pnl as total P&L. Then validate with OOS (walk-forward held-out window) and real-fills on the top 3 J days.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline
2. **Sample bias:** Using full 16-month dataset (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18). Selection: all available data. Overfit risk: Stage-1 is in-sample; OOS and real-fills will validate.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (to be performed after Stage-1)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (to be performed after Stage-1)
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day, max drawdown, blow-up scenario: unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest (top-5 days % of P&L)

## Pre-merge gate

- Gym validators: must pass for current engine.
- Walk-forward: OOS test must be positive and WF ratio >= 0.70.
- Real-fills: diff from BS-sim < ±20% on top 3 J days.
- Anchor no-regression: we are measuring edge_capture, so we will know if it changes relative to baseline (but baseline is what we are measuring).
